backstory.origin: A plated surveyor who develops stone barriers, support rigs and a bounded loose-object pull. Purchased larger verbs do not grant unlimited creation or free action economy. One DC uses the modified Physical attribute.
backstory.motivation: Find a place for these talents while protecting the people who rely on them.
backstory.ties: Traveling companions, former teachers, and a home worth returning to.
backstory.flaw: A familiar duty can become harder to set aside than a dangerous road.
